row.body: The compact house key is logged as returned before the moving list is complete. A folded map remains in the room beside the final box.
row.title: Compact home handoff

sidecar.gloss: The key returns while a moving list remains unfinished.
sidecar.rival_reading: A small move could finish in stages and leave a map behind; the log does not show who was expected to collect it.

row.body: opposite route arrows are painted on the sponge and folded road map. the older arrow was scraped away beneath fresh road grit.
row.title: missing count beside the sponge

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
